responsibility: Implements the C++ contracts experimental front-end support: parsing/retaining contract attributes and statements, deriving their runtime or assumption semantics, generating outlined precondition and postcondition helper functions, rewriting returns to enforce postconditions, and checking redeclaration and override compatibility of contracts. It is the main lowering and semantic enforcement file for guarded functions and contract runtime hooks.
same_name_distinction: Implements the contracts machinery declared in contracts.h: it performs semantic checking and lowering, including building outlined pre/postcondition helper functions, remapping conditions across redeclarations/overrides, and rewriting returns to invoke postcondition checks. Unlike the header, it is the executable implementation rather than the shared contract AST/API definition.
